name: The Accounting
description: A long, level room with the whole of it laid out: everything you did, arranged in a way that makes the pattern obvious. Nobody here is angry with you. That is the hard part. It is simply all here, and it is simply all yours.

objects.name: the pattern
looks: Obvious, now it is laid out. You did the same thing many times.
It goes back further than you had been counting from.
There is one decision near the start doing most of the work.

objects.name: the thing you did
looks: It is here with the rest, at the same size as the rest.
It waits for you to say something and does not rush you.
Seen from here it is small and it changed everything.

ambient: Another item is added to the accounting, quietly.
Your heart does something irregular, and the accounting does not pause for it.
weather: The room is the temperature of a waiting room and has been all night.
